sloka: कुरु राघव सत्येन वयस्यम् वन चारिणम् ।स हि स्थानानि सर्वाणि कार्त्स्न्येन कपि कुंजरः ॥३-७२-२२॥
transliteration: kuru rāghava satyena vayasyam vana cāriṇam ।sa hi sthānāni sarvāṇi kārtsnyena kapi kuṁjaraḥ ॥3-72-22॥

translations.english: He is the foremost of the monkeys. He knows well by his wisdom all the dwellingplaces of the carnivorous demons in the world.
